paite: Mihing pautuamte leh angel pautuamte in thu gen mah leng, itna ka neih keileh dak ging lel hiam, dakkhutbet ging lel hiam ka hi ding hi.
heading: Thilpiak Lianpen Itna Ahi
english: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

paite: Huan thugenkholh theihna nei in, thuguk tengteng leh theihna tengteng thei vek in, mual suantheihna khop hial ginna kim nei mah leng, itna ka neih keileh bangmah ka hi kei hi.
english: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

paite: Huan migentheite vakna ding in ka sum tengteng pe vek in, ka pumpi leng kang ding hial in kipe mah leng, itna ka neih keileh kei a ding in bangmah aphatuam kei hi.
english: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

paite: Itna in adohzou a, amigi a; itna in ahaza kei a, akisathei sam kei;
english: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

paite: itna aki-uangsak kei a, ahuham sam kei. Amah thu achi tentun kei a, ahehbaih kei, hehsa in a-omden sam kei;
english: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

paite: itna in gilou akipahpih kei a, adik akipahpih zaw hi.
english: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

paite: Itna in bangkim athuak teitei a, bangkim agingta a, bangkim alamen a, bangkim athuakkhe zel hi.
english: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

paite: Itna zaw chikchiang mah in abei kei ding; himahleh, thugenkholhnate om mahleh hihtawp ahong hi ding a, pautuamte om mahleh ahong tawp ding a, theihnate om mahleh hihtawp ahong hi ding.
english: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

paite: Akim lou in i thei ua, akim lou in thu i gen uhi.
english: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

paite: Akim ahong tun chiang in akim lou hihtawp ahita ding.
english: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

paite: Ka naupan lai in naupang pau in ka pau a, naupang theih in ka thei a, naupang ngaihtuah in ka ngaihtuah hi; tua ka hong pichin nung in naupang hihdan ka tawpsanta hi.
english: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

paite: Tu in zaw limlang ah i mu milmial ahi, huai hun chiang in zaw kimaituah in ahita ding hi. Tu in zaw akim lou in ka thei a, himahleh huai hun chiang in zaw theih khit a ka om bang in ka theikimta ding hi.
english: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

paite: Huchi in hiai thumte: ginna, lametna, itna, a-om gige ding ahi; himahleh hiaite a athupipen itna ahi.
english: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
